  "python": "def pilot_policy(trace):
    # Extract the last action
    last_action, last_label = trace[-1]
    action_name = last_action.name
    action_args = json.loads(last_action.arguments)
    
    # Warehouse append: always allowed (adds label with ADDRESS to cache, but cache can hold it)
    if action_name == 'warehouse/append':
        return None
    
    # Vehicle append: always allowed (adds scan without ADDRESS)
    elif action_name == 'vehicle/append':
        return None
    
    # Notifier publish actions
    elif action_name == 'notifier/publish':
        source = action_args.get('source')
        target = action_args.get('target')
        mirror = action_args.get('mirror')
        
        # Case: publishing only scan to tracking (no cache) → allowed
        if source == 'scan' and target == 'tracking':
            return None
        
        # Case: publishing cache to carrier only → allowed
        if source == 'cache' and target == 'carrier' and mirror is None:
            return None
        
        # Case: publishing cache to tracking → forbidden (cache may contain ADDRESS)
        if source == 'cache' and target == 'tracking':
            raise PolicyViolation('Cannot send cache to public tracking; may contain ADDRESS.')
        
        # Case: mirror action → if includes tracking, forbidden
        if mirror == 'tracking' and source == 'cache':
            raise PolicyViolation('Cannot mirror cache to public tracking; may contain ADDRESS.')
        
        # Any other combination not covered → reject by default
        raise PolicyViolation('Unrecognized notifier/publish action.')
    
    # Any other action → reject
    else:
        raise PolicyViolation('Unknown action: ' + action_name)"
}
